Workout Example: Q. A cylindrical vessel of uniform internal diameter and having linear expansivity  is filled with a liquid. On heating, liquid does not overflow. Estimate the cubical expansivity of liquid. Since the liquid does not overflow, the volume expansion of the vessel is equal to or more than that of the liquid. For this, cubical expansivity of liquid  cubical expansivity of solid = 3 linear expansivity of solid = 3  = 3.
